title: GD with small init recovers low-rank PSD matrix in over-parameterized matrix sensing
statement: Under (4r,δ)-RIP, gradient descent on f(U)=1/(2m)Σ(y_i-<A_i,UU^T>)^2 with U∈R^{d×d}, initialization U0=αB (B orthonormal) and small step size achieves ||U_T U_T^T - X*||_F^2 ≲ α√d/κ^2 for every T in the range (κ log(d/α))/η ≲ T ≲ 1/(η√d κ α).
test_plan: Simulate with d=100, r=5, U* Gaussian with columns normalized, X*=U*U*^T, and m=5dr symmetric Gaussian A_i. Run GD with η=0.0025 and α∈{1e-1,1e-2,1e-3,1e-4}, using U0=αI. For each α, record ||UU^T-X*||_F^2 after convergence (around 1e4 iterations), averaged over 3 seeds. Then regress log(error) on log(α).
evidence_in_paper: Theorem 1.1 and Theorem 4.1 (proof); Figures 1-3 give empirical support.
success_criterion: Final squared recovery error decreases as α decreases, consistent with O(α√d) scaling: the fitted log-log slope is positive (about 1), and error is small (≪1) for small α while the training loss is near zero.
success_criterion_source: derived from the claim's error bound ∝ α√d/κ^2

title: Generalization gap narrows as initialization scale decreases (Fig. 1)
statement: With m=5dr, r=5, U0=αI, step size 0.0025 and 1e4 GD iterations, the gap between training and test error decreases as α decreases from 1 to 1e-3, for d=100 and d=200.
test_plan: Reproduce the Figure 1 setup for d∈{100,200} and α∈{10^0,10^-0.5,...,10^-3}, with 3 resamplings of A_i. Compute relative training error and relative test error ||X̂-X*||_F/||X*||_F, and plot the gap against α.
success_criterion: The test-train gap is smaller at α=1e-3 than at α=1, and shows a decreasing trend as α decreases for both d.
success_criterion_source: paper states gap decreases as α decreases

title: Large init overfits: training error <1e-4 but test error ~1e-1 (Fig. 2)
statement: With α=1.0, training error falls below 1e-4 while test error stays on the order of 1e-1. With α=1e-3, test error is much lower.
test_plan: Use d=100, r=5, m=5dr, η=0.0025, and run 2e4 GD iterations for α=1 and α=1e-3 over 3 seeds. Track training and test error.
success_criterion: For α=1, training error <1e-4 and test error ~1e-1 (between 1e-2 and 1). Test error for α=1e-3 is lower than for α=1.

title: No early stopping needed: test error keeps decreasing up to 1e5 iterations (Fig. 3)
statement: With U0=0.01I, m=5dr, r=5 and step size 0.0025, test error keeps decreasing gradually over 1e5 GD iterations and does not diverge, for d=100 and 200.
test_plan: Run GD for 1e5 iterations with d∈{100,200} and log test error every 1e3 iterations.
success_criterion: Test error at 1e5 iterations is ≤ test error at earlier checkpoints (e.g., 2e4) and shows no divergence; final test error is around 0.02 or below.
success_criterion_source: Figure 3 shows test error ≤0.02 at the end

title: Factorized GD outperforms projected GD on PSD cone (Fig. 4)
statement: For rank-1 X* and m from 5d to 35d, GD on the factorized model consistently recovers X* accurately, while PGD in X-space with projection onto the PSD cone needs more samples and degrades as d increases from 100 to 150.
test_plan: Use rank 1, d∈{100,150} and m∈{5d,...,35d}. Run both methods with step 0.0025, stopping when training error <0.001 or after 1e4 iterations. Record test error for each.
success_criterion: Factorized GD test error is low across all m. PGD test error is higher than GD at small m, and PGD at d=150 is worse than at d=100.

title: SGD/GD from identity initialization fits training data but fails to generalize (Fig. 5)
statement: With U0=I, d=100, r=5 and m=5dr, both SGD (step 8e-5, one sample per step) and GD drive training error to about 1e-7 while test error remains large.
test_plan: Run GD with U0=I until training error is about 1e-7, then measure test error. Run SGD with a reduced iteration budget (the paper uses 4e6) and track both errors.
success_criterion: Training error ≤ about 1e-6 while relative test error stays on the order of 1e-1 or larger.
success_criterion_source: paper states test error remains large
